verdict.line: You lose if you eat repeated Tongue Lash stacks before level 3 and let him hit 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste; you win once E and R are online and you force the all-in yourself.

brief.thesis: Sett's win rate here (55.6% over 261 games, lane and solo-kill edge) comes from out-scaling Tahm Kench's early poke the moment E (Facebreaker) and R (The Show Stopper) come online at levels 3 and 6. Tahm's Q (Tongue Lash) builds An Acquired Taste stacks toward a 0-cooldown Devour, so the lane is about denying those stacks before level 3, then using Haymaker's stored Grit and Knuckle Down's max-health damage to punish his melee trades once you can fight back.

tell.watch: his An Acquired Taste stack count

theirWindow.what: Tongue Lash (900 range) slows and pokes you with no punish available, and each hit stacks An Acquired Taste toward a stun/Devour at 3 stacks. Hold trades and break line of sight through minions until level 3.

yourWindow.when: once W's stored Grit is full
yourWindow.what: Haymaker passively banks the damage you take as Grit; after tanking 3-4 exchanged hits, pop it for the shield plus true-damage center hit, landing Tahm in that center per OP.GG's own read on this matchup.

runes.keystoneWhy: Sustained melee trading fits Sett's plan of tanking hits for Grit and then all-inning; Conqueror's stacking adaptive damage builds through the same extended exchanges.

summoners.why: 87.6% pick rate at 55.4% win rate; Ignite closes out the solo-kill window this matchup already favors, and denies both Thick Skin's passive heal and Tongue Lash's lifesteal during your all-in.

playing.title: Track his stack count, not just HP
playing.detail: An Acquired Taste stacks from each Tongue Lash hit; at 3 stacks he can Devour you for free (0 cooldown) with a lockdown and magic damage. Back off when he's one Q away from 3 stacks.

playing.title: Dodge Q before level 3
playing.detail: Tongue Lash has 900 range and you have no E yet to punish the cast. Weave behind minions so he can't land it for free.

playing.title: Land E with minions behind him
playing.detail: Facebreaker only stuns if enemies are on opposite sides of you; pure 1v1 away from the wave just slows him. Walk him toward your minions before casting.

playing.title: All-in once Grit is full
playing.detail: Haymaker stores damage you take as Grit passively. Trade autos for 3-4 exchanges first, then pop W for the shield and true-damage center hit.

playing.title: Use Q to punish his health stacking
playing.detail: Knuckle Down's bonus damage scales off his max health, directly cutting into the value of his passive and any HP items he buys.

playing.title: Ignite through his shield window
playing.detail: Thick Skin can pop a near-instant shield (3s cooldown) off stored damage. Bait it with autos before committing full burst, or just Ignite to cut through the sustain entirely.

playing.title: Save R for a clean lockdown
playing.detail: The Show Stopper is 120/100/80/80/80s cooldown, so don't waste it poking; use it to guarantee the kill window once Grit and Ignite are both up.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and win rates are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical reasoning and trade-pattern advice are my own read on how the abilities interact.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being chased by Tahm Kench’s (Q) during early game. Afterwards, try to him at the center of [W] when fighting him.
